sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied carolina-national-high-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site, not an asserted capture URL. Affine independent check errors: 6.92 m, 10.74 m. Does not meet the 5 m registration gate; conservative source-constrained estimates only. Western red roof, northern long classroom and central classroom provide distributed matches; retain green courtyard islands and clear paths between roofs. Added the clear northeast end of the north roof to constrain shear across the campus; independent central and northwest roof checks remain excluded. Imagery-to-OSM disagreements are clipped to complete mapped obstacles; no surveyed boundary, species, court markings, construction date or exact inventory inferred. No bitmap ships.
